import importlib.util, os, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('rc', 'tools/registry-check.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
print('proc_numeric_entries', sum(1 for e in os.listdir('/proc') if e.isdecimal()))
for k in range(3):
    t = time.perf_counter(); snap = m._process_snapshot(); d = time.perf_counter() - t
    print('snapshot_%d entries=%d seconds=%.4f' % (k, len(snap), d))
t = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(1000):
    with open('/proc/self/stat', 'rb') as fh:
        fh.read()
d = time.perf_counter() - t
print('proc_self_stat_open_read_x1000 seconds=%.4f per_open_us=%.1f' % (d, d * 1000.0))
print('loadavg', open('/proc/loadavg').read().split()[:3])
